_meta.purpose: Legality-pinning conformance vectors. Legality is judged by RESULTING BOARD, not step decomposition: apply the returned steps to `board` and compare the canonical key against `legalResults`. Strength is never asserted — a weak but legal engine passes.
_meta.boardKey: points (24 on-roll-frame counts, +=on-roll) joined by comma, then |bar:onRoll,opp|off:onRoll,opp. Steps: from 0 = bar, to 0 = off. Hits are DERIVED: landing on exactly one opposing checker sends it to the opponent bar.
_meta.sources: plain positions from the gnubg 2-ply refset (bar-position refset ids are corrupt and excluded); bar-entry/dance/bearoff positions from deterministic walked games encoded by the validated encoder
